subject: CS476
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. The English selections are from highly-regarded academic sources like Martin Kleppmann and university channels, covering the topics in depth. The Arabic selections provide strong, practical problem-solving examples for the core clock and mutual exclusion topics. Coverage for multicasting topics in Arabic was sparse, with all relevant candidates failing the minimum quality gates (view count).

coverage.note: All candidates failed the view count gate.
Relevant candidates failed the view count gate; high-view candidates were about C# delegates, not distributed systems.

videos.title: Distributed Systems 4.1: Logical time
videos.filter_reason: A high-quality lecture from a renowned expert that explains logical time from first principles, providing essential context before detailing vector clocks.

videos.title: Distributed Systems 3.3: Causality and happens-before
videos.filter_reason: This video perfectly addresses the core concept of the 'happened-before' relationship, which is fundamental to understanding Lamport's clocks.

videos.title: Ricart Agrawala Mutual Exclusion algorithm in Distributed Systems Synchronization
videos.filter_reason: A clear, well-animated explanation of the Ricart-Agrawala algorithm with a step-by-step example that is easy to follow.

videos.title: Module 6.2.1 BSS Algorithm Causal Ordering of Messages
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a detailed, academic walkthrough of the Birman-Schiper-Stephenson (BSS) protocol, which is a key algorithm for implementing causal ordering.

videos.title: Total Order Broadcast | Vivien Quema
videos.filter_reason: A concise and focused academic video that explains the concept and implementation of total order broadcast clearly and effectively.

videos.title: شرح مسألة ال vector logical clock فى مادة ال Distributed
videos.filter_reason: This is a highly relevant and popular video that provides a detailed walkthrough of a vector clock problem, which is excellent for student practice.

videos.title: شرح مسألة ال scalar (lampart logical clock) فى مادة ال Distributed
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive explanation and problem-solving session for Lamport clocks, with a high view count indicating its usefulness to students.

videos.title: حل مشكلة تزامن الميقاتيات - خوارزمية ريكار وأغراوالا Ricart & Agrawala
videos.filter_reason: This is the best available Arabic video specifically covering the Ricart & Agrawala algorithm, explaining how it solves the mutual exclusion problem.
